blocking_findings.message: Normally enabled native LoD and complete normal-play delivery acceptance remain unmet.
An empty build permanently suppresses ordinary rebuilds in the same engine/camera section despite later ingestion, edits, resize or atlas replacement.
With a live engine, the rendering-off configuration/menu action stops only the nullable GL renderer, while native switch-driven every-frame rendering continues.

Render gate/replay accepts contradictory diagnostic activity, diagnostic command flags, missing thumbnails, failed environment completion, incomplete checkpoint coverage, validation/application log errors and stage snapshots outside their harness stage.

non_blocking_findings.message: 20/22 named removals detected by the new class; both remaining guards are reachable within the finite-number/extent domain. Correct unchanged refusals remain, but blanket unreachable claims are false.
Fresh 37-predicate shared-helper audit: hierarchy-only tests detect 10, 27 survive; real-LOAD detects all 37.

Older living context still says no native implementation/borrowing and only GL interop wired, while newer sections describe the experimental native product route. Delivery remains explicitly unaccepted.
